enemies.name: Space Barracuda
descriptions: Will periodically bend space and teleport to a new location.
Fires ranged projectiles of quantum energy.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs nearby fallen robots, bringing them back to life if given enough time.
Can use its repair tools as melee weapons if given the opportunity.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.

enemies.name: Illust the Accelerator
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Scorpiod
descriptions: Fast moving, closes in for quick melee attacks.
Can trade movement speed for high resistance to area effect damage.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.

enemies.name: Zunh the Singularity Void
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Draining Simian
descriptions: Can drain health over time if it gets close enough to its target.
Becomes exhausted for a short time after stealing a significant amount of health.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: Lobs a projectile that will curse any heroes caught in the small area of effect.
The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.

enemies.name: Pyro
descriptions: Has a short range fire breath attack that can hit multiple targets within its area.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Charges heroes dealing physical damage.
Attacks with energy damage when up close.
Explodes after dying, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Mizod the Life Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.

enemies.name: Muting Leucopod
descriptions: Emits slow moving projectiles that will silence heroes on impact.
Will sometimes strafe between attacks.

enemies.name: Vampiric Leaper
descriptions: Leaps from place to place to move around.
When landing near a hero, emits a damaging area effect attack.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
If it manages to surprise a hero, it will scream, terrifying anyone near it.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

enemies.name: Nashira, The Shadow Void
descriptions: Lobs shadow attacks and creates mirror images

While protected in the sphere, calls down space debris in an attempt to crush its target.

enemies.name: Marqx the Fiery Terror
descriptions: Occasionally launches a chunk of magma at each nearby hero, creating a damaging lava pool.
Has a standard melee attack when it manages to get close.

enemies.name: Root Mob
descriptions: Has a melee attack that will briefly root the hero in place.
Getting hit by Dread Root will allow its friends to close in as well.

enemies.name: Invisible Slayer
descriptions: Surprises heroes by appearing out of stealth nearby.
Engages in close range melee combat.

enemies.name: Pyro Destructionist
descriptions: Has a short range fire breath attack that can hit multiple targets within its area.

enemies.name: Phytovoric Tunneler
descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

enemies.name: Blood Pterodyne
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
If it manages to surprise a hero, it will scream, terrifying anyone near it.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.

enemies.name: Spirit Drifter
descriptions: Very difficult to hit with physical attacks.
Charges through heroes silencing them in the process.
Emits an aura that slowly drains life from all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Tunax the Toxic Terror
descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

enemies.name: Triocular Electrocutionist
descriptions: Has a close range arc lightning attack that will jump between targets.
These lightning arcs will diminish in damage after each jump.

enemies.name: Temporal Striker
descriptions: Has a tail strike that damages and slows the heroes' movement and attack speed.
Runs away when others of its species perish nearby.

enemies.name: Contagion Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Ray Killer Rex
descriptions: Unleashes blazing fast lightning bolts that travel horizontally and can pierce multiple heroes.
Each target in range causes him to launch an additional bolt.
Flees when struck in combat, turning back only to send out lightning.

enemies.name: Master Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.

enemies.name: Arachno Terror
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

enemies.name: Kamin the Electrocuting Vengeance
descriptions: Unleashes blazing fast lightning bolts that travel horizontally and can pierce multiple heroes.
Each target in range causes him to launch an additional bolt.
Flees when struck in combat, turning back only to send out lightning.

enemies.name: Blitzing Drakon
descriptions: Flying enemy with a physical melee attack.
Moves and attacks more quickly when near others of its species.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl Rex
descriptions: Lobs a projectile that will curse any heroes caught in the small area of effect.
The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.

enemies.name: Hover-Bot Proton
descriptions: Flying robots that connect to each other with damaging laser beams.

enemies.name: Singularity Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Spirit Drifter
descriptions: Very difficult to hit with physical attacks.
Charges through heroes silencing them in the process.
Emits an aura that slowly drains life from all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Pouncing Devourer
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

enemies.name: Cyluk the Wormhole Dominator
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Parasitic Exploder
descriptions: Drains power over time from heroes in an effort to replenish its supply.
When full, will run towards the nearest hero and explode, causing area effect damage.

enemies.name: Rampaging Grendel
descriptions: High hit point melee enemy who can charge at faraway heroes.

enemies.name: Swift Raider
descriptions: Fast flying close range attacker that can swarm heroes.
Shifted form allows it to defend strongly against area effect attacks.

enemies.name: Malignant Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.

enemies.name: Deathwing Terrorsaur
descriptions: Throws multiple fireballs in a spread pattern.
Heroes who are hit by a fireball will burn and take damage over time.

enemies.name: Raytheoid Delta
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

enemies.name: Sumaya the Loathing Succubus
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.

enemies.name: Bursting Scarab
descriptions: Runs towards the nearest hero and explodes nearby.
Being caught in the explosion will stun and damage heroes.

enemies.name: Hyper Nova
descriptions: Runs towards the nearest hero and explodes.
The explosion will cause nearby heroes to burn, taking heavy amounts of damage over time.

enemies.name: Parasitic Exploder
descriptions: Drains power over time from heroes in an effort to replenish its supply.
When full, will run towards the nearest hero and explode, causing area effect damage.

enemies.name: Grenadier Ultra
descriptions: Has an impenetrable shield that prevents all damage from the front.
Lobs exploding cluster grenades from behind the shield.
Will knock back heroes that venture too close to his front.

enemies.name: Rampaging Juggernaut
descriptions: Charges heroes dealing physical damage.
Attacks with energy damage when up close.
Explodes after dying, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Caustic Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.

enemies.name: TSE-PAK the Planetary Annihilator
descriptions: Has an impenetrable shield that prevents all damage from the front.
Lobs exploding cluster grenades from behind the shield.
Will knock back heroes that venture too close to his front.

enemies.name: Detonating Kinetic Mines
descriptions: Attempts to close in to melee range to attack.
Leaves behind mines after death that explode on contact.

enemies.name: Spiked Triped
descriptions: Launches thorns in a circular pattern.
A thorny exterior makes it resistant to physical damage.
Heroes who use physical melee attacks will take damage in return.

enemies.name: Eclectic Predator
descriptions: Blinks into melee range with its target and unleashes a rapid fire melee attack.
After attacking, blinks away and bides its time before blinking in again.

enemies.name: Subversionist Undermind
descriptions: Can ignite heroes and increase their energy vulnerability, and apply a fiery buff to allies

enemies.name: Animus Resurrector
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.

enemies.name: Supreme Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.

enemies.name: Croucher the Agile Devourer
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

Can charge through heroes, damaging anyone it touches.

enemies.name: Rampaging Grendel
descriptions: High hit point melee enemy who can charge at faraway heroes.

enemies.name: Ragetusk Vengeance
descriptions: Has a vicious charge that will knock affected heroes up into the air.
Enrages when nearby corrupted are killed, growing in size and dealing more damage.

Emits an aura that slowly drains life from all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Rampaging Juggernaut
descriptions: Charges heroes dealing physical damage.

Explodes after dying, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Kobw the Maleficent
descriptions: Heals nearby friends who are heavily damaged.
Roots players in place and calls all nearby friends to attack them.

descriptions: Will periodically bend space and teleport to a new location.
Fires ranged projectiles of quantum energy.

enemies.name: Reparatron Gamma
descriptions: Repairs nearby fallen robots, bringing them back to life if given enough time.
Can use its repair tools as melee weapons if given the opportunity.

enemies.name: Ionic Sloth
descriptions: Attacks when in close range combat.
Slow moving but will aggressively chase any hero that comes in close proximity.

enemies.name: Magnetic Mastermind
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Grenadier Ultra
descriptions: Has an impenetrable shield that prevents all damage from the front.
Lobs exploding cluster grenades from behind the shield.
Will knock back heroes that venture too close to his front.

enemies.name: Arachno Terror
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Grand Pyrachnid
descriptions: Melee enemy that is completely shrouded in fire.
Heroes who come into contact with it will catch on fire as well.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech-X
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage.
Has a rapid fire machine gun attack.

enemies.name: Vampiric Vaulter
descriptions: Leaps from place to place to move around.
When landing near a hero, emits a damaging area effect attack.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller Assassin
descriptions: Fires devastating volleys of four lightning orbs at a time.
Becomes exhausted for a short period after each volley.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist Annihilator
descriptions: Can slam the ground, knocking nearby heroes up into the air.
When damaged, will use a repair arm to restore its own health.

enemies.name: Raging Pulsar
descriptions: Pulls its target into melee range with dual gravitic beams.
Anyone caught by the beams will be slowed afterwards.
Follows up a successful pull with rapid-fire melee attacks.

enemies.name: Deccos the Lightning Assassin
descriptions: Fires devastating volleys of four lightning orbs at a time.
Becomes exhausted for a short period after each volley.

enemies.name: Exovoric Leucopod
descriptions: Emits slow moving projectiles that will silence heroes on impact.
Will sometimes strafe between attacks.

enemies.name: Toxivore
descriptions: Attempts to close with the hero to use a short range melee attack.
Each melee attack that connects has a chance to inject poison.

enemies.name: Particle Burster
descriptions: Can unleash a lightning bolt that instantly hits its target.
Can't build up enough of a charge on nearby targets, causing the attack to fizzle.

enemies.name: Carrion Maw
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.

enemies.name: Sabre Mantis
descriptions: Can lob a spore pod that breaks open and forms a sleeping cloud in a small area.
Will close on sleeping heroes and hit them with a melee swipe attack.

enemies.name: Raytheoid Delta
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

enemies.name: Ernox the Insatiable Maw
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.

enemies.name: Kiloton Blastopod
descriptions: Launches homing missiles while in stationary mode.
Switches modes when it needs to turn or move.

enemies.name: Homing Blaster
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.

enemies.name: Clustering Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary plant-like enemy that will become active when threatened.
When angered, it launches slow homing attacks that will ruthlessly chase after their target.

enemies.name: Annihilation Mechanoid
descriptions: Jams nearby communications, silencing all heroes who get too close.
Launches homing missiles that will cause the targeted hero to be briefly stunned as well as dazed.
Uses the opportunity created by the missiles to close in and slam heroes with its fist.

enemies.name: Ray Killer Rex
descriptions: Unleashes blazing fast lightning bolts that travel horizontally and can pierce multiple heroes.
Each target in range causes him to launch an additional bolt.
Flees when struck in combat, turning back only to send out lightning.

enemies.name: Arachno Terror
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

enemies.name: RBT-66 the Lockdown Automaton
descriptions: Jams nearby communications, silencing all heroes who get too close.
Launches homing missiles that will cause the targeted hero to be briefly stunned as well as dazed.
Uses the opportunity created by the missiles to close in and slam heroes with its fist.

enemies.name: Swarming Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary plant-like enemy that will become active when threatened.
When angered, it launches slow homing attacks that will ruthlessly chase after their target.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Attempts to close with the hero to use a short range melee attack.
Each melee attack that connects has a chance to inject poison.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee robot.
Surrounded by a protective shield that will absorb damage and recharge periodically.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals nearby friends who are heavily damaged.
Roots players in place and calls all nearby friends to attack them.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

enemies.name: Contagion the Deadly Epidemic
descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

enemies.name: Polaris, The Gravity Manipulator
descriptions: Creates gravity orbs, cone push attack, rapid fire projectiles

enemies.name: Sniping Drakon
descriptions: Flying enemy with a physical melee attack.
Moves and attacks more quickly when near others of its species.

enemies.name: Homing Shot
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.

enemies.name: Stifling Tracker
descriptions: Body is ghostly, giving it a very high chance to dodge physical attacks.
Can charge through heroes, damaging anyone it touches.

enemies.name: Temporal Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Pterodyne Terror
descriptions: Will stealth in an attempt to move in close.
If it manages to surprise a hero, it will scream, terrifying anyone near it.
Melee attacks cause the hero to become vulnerable to future physical damage.

enemies.name: Targeting Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

enemies.name: Mikk the Luminal Aggressor
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Blitzing Drakon
descriptions: Flying enemy with a physical melee attack.
Moves and attacks more quickly when near others of its species.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl Rex
descriptions: Lobs a projectile that will curse any heroes caught in the small area of effect.
The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.

enemies.name: Hover-Bot Proton
descriptions: Flying robots that connect to each other with damaging laser beams.

enemies.name: Singularity Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Spirit Drifter
descriptions: Very difficult to hit with physical attacks.
Charges through heroes silencing them in the process.
Emits an aura that slowly drains life from all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Pouncing Devourer
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

enemies.name: Cyluk the Wormhole Dominator
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Vampiric Vaulter

descriptions: Fires devastating volleys of four lightning orbs at a time.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist Annihilator

enemies.name: Deccos the Lightning Assassin
descriptions: Fires devastating volleys of four lightning orbs at a time.

enemies.name: Homing Blaster

enemies.name: Clustering Herbipod

When angered, it launches slow homing attacks that will ruthlessly chase after their target.

enemies.name: Annihilation Mechanoid
descriptions: Jams nearby communications, silencing all heroes who get too close.
Launches homing missiles that will cause the targeted hero to be briefly stunned as well as dazed.
Uses the opportunity created by the missiles to close in and slam heroes with its fist.

enemies.name: Hyper Nova

enemies.name: Grenadier Ultra

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Charges heroes dealing physical damage.
Attacks with energy damage when up close.
Explodes after dying, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Mizod the Life Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.

enemies.name: Hover-Bot
descriptions: Flying robots that connect to each other with damaging laser beams.

enemies.name: Nova
descriptions: Runs towards the nearest hero and explodes.
The explosion will cause nearby heroes to burn, taking heavy amounts of damage over time.

enemies.name: Sinkhole
descriptions: Periodically summons a gravity well that pulls in nearby heroes and projectiles.
Takes reduced damage when channeling the gravity well ability.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Can ignite heroes and increase their energy vulnerability, and apply a fiery buff to allies

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.

enemies.name: Kaai the Craven Blaster
descriptions: Can ignite heroes and increase their energy vulnerability, and apply a fiery buff to allies

descriptions: Attempts to close in to melee range to attack.
Leaves behind mines after death that explode on contact.

enemies.name: Thorn Triped
descriptions: Launches thorns in a circular pattern.
A thorny exterior makes it resistant to physical damage.
Heroes who use physical melee attacks will take damage in return.

enemies.name: Shadower
descriptions: Fast moving enemies that strafe while closing in on heroes.
Has a vicious melee attack that causes the target to make more damage from future physical attacks.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Charges heroes dealing physical damage.
Attacks with energy damage when up close.
Explodes after dying, dealing damage to all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pulls its target into melee range with dual gravitic beams.
Anyone caught by the beams will be slowed afterwards.
Follows up a successful pull with rapid-fire melee attacks.

enemies.name: Feng the Relentless Predator
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.

After attacking, blinks away and bides its time before blinking in again.

enemies.name: Maser Tank
descriptions: Attacks heroes with a short range laser emitter.
Will scan allies for debuffs and send out a cleansing pulse when necessary.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

enemies.name: DLS-1227 the Impenetrable Defender
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.

When angered, it launches slow homing attacks that will ruthlessly chase after their target.

Each melee attack that connects has a chance to inject poison.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee robot.
Surrounded by a protective shield that will absorb damage and recharge periodically.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals nearby friends who are heavily damaged.
Roots players in place and calls all nearby friends to attack them.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Fires piercing laser attacks that can go through multiple heroes.
Can place a buff on nearby allies that greatly increases their energy damage.

descriptions: Burrows underground and tunnels until close to a hero.
Springs from the earth launching a poison area effect attack.

Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Scorpiod
descriptions: Fast moving, closes in for quick melee attacks.
Can trade movement speed for high resistance to area effect damage.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.

enemies.name: Warp Spawner
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.

enemies.name: Zunh the Singularity Void
descriptions: Being shifted halfway into an alternate dimension makes them highly resistant to area effect attacks.
Launches time-space warping projectiles that will randomly teleport heroes who are hit by them.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Flying enemy with a physical melee attack.
Moves and attacks more quickly when near others of its species.

enemies.name: Chrono Striker
descriptions: Has a tail strike that damages and slows the heroes' movement and attack speed.
Runs away when others of its species perish nearby.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Shoots ranged projectiles that move fairly slowly.
Strafes sideways between attacks.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Launches slow moving homing projectiles, that cause little damage, but will terrify a hero on impact.
Chases after terrified heroes and attacks them from melee range.

enemies.name: Polaris, The Gravity Manipulator
descriptions: Creates gravity orbs, cone push attack, rapid fire projectiles
